about.title: About L&M Multiservices
text: First and foremost, I'm a proud and blessed mom of three beautiful kids. They're the heartbeat of my life and the driving force behind everything I do.

With almost a decade of experience in filing taxes, I've proudly served the Channelview community. Over the years, I've developed a deep understanding of the unique needs and challenges facing individuals and businesses in our area.

My journey into the world of taxes wasn't just about numbers and forms; it was about building relationships and making a positive impact in people's lives. I believe in offering more than just tax services – I'm here to provide guidance, support, and peace of mind to every client who walks through our doors.
